title: Deck
description: A page as a slide deck: a cover, then one slide per screen over the Sunset waves. A page uses it with layout: deck.

title.description: The cover's headline, the page's title in the navigation and in search results

eyebrow.description: A short line above the cover's headline

description.description: The cover's standfirst, and the page's description for search results

more.description: The text of a link on the cover to the first slide, such as Learn more. Needs moreTarget

moreTarget.description: The anchor of the slide the cover's link goes to: that slide's anchor value
